The vendor directly providing **Font Awesome** at **fontawesome.com** is **Fonticons, Inc.** (doing business as Font Awesome).

### Evidence:
* **Terms of Service** (`fontawesome.com`):  
  > *"By using the fontawesome.com website ("Service"), or any services of Fonticons, Inc. ("Font Awesome"), you agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions..."*
* **Privacy Policy** (`fontawesome.com`):  
  > *"...explains the rights and policies concerning Fonticons, Inc.'s doing business as Font Awesome ('we,' 'our,' or the 'company's') — including its Web Awesome products, websites (fontawesome.com and webawesome.com), and related services..."*
* **Font Awesome Pro License** (`fontawesome.com`):  
  > *"Fonticons, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the Company) and the company or individual who has purchased or is presently purchasing a Font Awesome Pro license through the Web Store at fontawesome.com..."*
